newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close lower,focus remains on Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close lower,focus remains on Wall St.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Thursday, depressed by losses on Wall Street and other stock markets. Dealers said the market would remain focussed on movements in U.S. stocks.
The general index slipped 2.36 points, 0.51 percent, to 461.67. while the Ibex-35 of leading shares dropped 30.52 points, 0.57 percent, to 5,279.90.
"The market is following the trend on Wall Street and the U.S. close today will dictate the direction tomorrow," said one dealer.
But turnover moderate with 59 billion pesetas changing hands.
Telefonica was again the most active stock, accounting for 22.6 percent of turnover, and closed down 45 pesetas to 3,245.
In the banking sector, most stocks closed down with Banesto and Santander suffering most, losing more than 1.2 percent.
